name: CHEG 3112
title: Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics II
description: Properties and phase equilibria for ideal and non-ideal mixtures; design of equilibrium flash separators; phase equilibria using equations of state; chemical equilibria; optimum conditions for chemical reactions; applications include chemical, electrochemical and biochemical systems.
requirement_description: CHEG 2111; MATH 2410Q; open only to School of Engineering students.
